tool_schemas.name: list_documentation
tool_schemas.description: Returns the documentation source catalog (name, url, description, category, tags, version) optionally filtered by `category` and/or `tag`; results are returned as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if provided filters are empty or not strings. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to read the catalog and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: add_documentation
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new documentation source entry with the provided `name`, `url`, and `category` (and optional description, tags, and version) and returns the created source record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, when `url` is not a valid URL string, or when `tags` is not an array of strings. Raises CONFLICT if a source with the same `name` already exists, UNAUTHORIZED if you cannot modify the catalog, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: update_documentation
tool_schemas.description: Starts an update job for the named documentation source to fetch and re-index its content, returning the job status/acknowledgement for that run; when `force` is false, the service may refuse to re-run a recently completed update. Raises NOT_FOUND if no source exists with that `name` and VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is empty or `force` is not a boolean. Raises CONFLICT if an update is already in progress for that source (or if a non-forced update is not allowed due to recency), UNAUTHORIZED if you cannot run updates, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

name.description: Name of the documentation to update

force.description: Force update even if recently updated

tool_schemas.name: search_documentation
tool_schemas.description: Searches the locally indexed documentation content for `query` and returns matching results, optionally filtered by `category` and/or `tag`; results are returned as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `query` is empty or filters are not valid strings. Raises CONFLICT when a search is requested for a source that has not been indexed yet, UNAUTHORIZED if you cannot query the index, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: remove_documentation
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the named documentation source from the catalog and removes its associated local index, returning a removal confirmation. Raises NOT_FOUND if no source exists with that `name` and VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is empty. Raises CONFLICT if the source cannot be removed because an update job is currently running for it, UNAUTHORIZED if you cannot modify the catalog, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

name.description: Name of the documentation to remove

tool_schemas.name: get_documentation
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single documentation source by its authoritative `name` and returns the full source record (including status, timestamps, cooldown, and tags). Raises NOT_FOUND if no source exists with that `name`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is empty or not a string. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to read the catalog and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

name.description: Name of the documentation source to fetch

tool_schemas.name: list_update_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists update jobs, optionally filtered by documentation `name` and/or job `status`, returning results in reverse chronological order. Raises NOT_FOUND if `name` is provided and no source exists with that `name`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you cannot read job history and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

name.description: Filter jobs by documentation source name

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return (default 50)

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call

tool_schemas.name: get_update_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single update job by its `job_id` and returns its current status and details (including timestamps, error information, and indexing counts). Raises NOT_FOUND if no job exists with that id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `job_id` is empty or not a string. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you cannot read job details and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_update_job
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an in-progress update job (`queued` or `running`) by `job_id` and returns the updated job record. Refuses cancellation for jobs already in a terminal state (`succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled`). Raises NOT_FOUND if no job exists with that id, VALIDATION_ERROR if `job_id` is invalid, CONFLICT if the job cannot be cancelled due to its current state, UNAUTHORIZED if you cannot modify jobs, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: list_documents
tool_schemas.description: Lists indexed documents for a documentation source by `name`, optionally filtered by document `status` and/or language, with pagination. Returns document metadata (and optionally content) from the local index. Raises NOT_FOUND if no source exists with that `name`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you cannot read indexed documents and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

name.description: Documentation source name whose documents will be listed

include_content.description: When true, includes `content_text` in each returned document (default false)

limit.description: Maximum number of documents to return (default 50)

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call

metadata.name: Aindreyway Codex Keeper
metadata.description: Codex Keeper stores a catalog of documentation sources (name/url/category/tags/version) and maintains a locally searchable content index for each source. Core workflows are: add/list/remove sources, run update jobs to fetch and re-index content, and execute searches with optional category/tag filter
